newsitem.title: KUWAIT: Kuwait to raise tobacco customs to 100pct in July.
newsitem.headline: Kuwait to raise tobacco customs to 100pct in July.

text.p: Kuwait will raise customs duty on tobacco and its products to 100 percent from 50 percent in July, an official was quoted as saying on Monday.
The head of the customs department, Ibrahim al-Ghanem, told al-Anba newspaper the decision was in line with a Gulf Cooperation Council (GCC) accord to raise duty on cigarettes and tobacco.
The six-nation alliance held a meeting in January to coordinate a phased increase to 100 percent.

The Kuwaiti daily said that GCC members Oman, United Arab Emirates, Qatar and Bahrain had already reached the target while Kuwait and Saudi Arabia, the most populous of the six, were still to implement the plan.
